text:
anya: Heads up — nightly on main is red. The `fetch-secrets` step fails with KMS decrypt denied. cc @samir https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/987654321

ci-bot: job: infra-nightly (build) failed in step `fetch-secrets`
```
  Error: KMS Decrypt failed: permissionDenied
  rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes
```
\nsamir: which repo / workflow?

anya: repo infra/runner, workflow `nightly-bundle`. Link above. Error started ~ 00:05 UTC. No other errors in job.

marc: can someone try a rerun first? if rerun passes then maybe transient. if it stays red we should bisect recent infra config changes. :mag:

olivia: i pushed a change yesterday to rotate the Vault->KMS mapping (see PR #412). I *might* have missed granting the github-actions service account the decrypt role on the new key.

samir: ok checking IAM for the KMS key. running:
```
  gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/nightly-key --format=json
```
\nsamir: output looks like this — binding for `serviceAccount:github-actions@github.com` is NOT present:
```
  {
    "bindings": [
      {"role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypter", "members": ["serviceAccount:vault-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
    ]
  }
```
\nolivia: yeah that matches my suspicion. i updated the key itself but forgot to add the GSA. my bad.

marc: please add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for the GitHub Actions service account and then rerun. commands:
```
  gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/nightly-key \
    --member="serviceAccount:github-actions@github.com" \
    --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
\nsamir: applying now.

ci-bot: rerun requested by samir — requeued job infra-nightly (build) #987654322

ci-bot: job succeeded on rerun.

anya: confirmed — nightly passed after adding the binding. closing the loop. thanks @olivia and @samir :white_check_mark:

marc: quick follow-up — olivia, can you add a line to PR #412 to include the IAM binding step in the rotation playbook so we don't miss this next time?

olivia: will do, adding a checklist item and a smoke test to verify decrypt after rotation.

anya: note for postmortem: transient vs config-change triage — this was config. no rollback needed. keeping thread for archive.
